_readme: Self-heal layer for the rafiu.me rates pipeline. Apps Script fetches this file from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rafiu-Tahmid/rafiu-site/main/rates-overrides.json on EVERY run, so a fix here goes live with a normal git push - no Apps Script redeploy. A faster channel exists too: the 'Overrides' tab inside the Google Sheet, same field names, and the Sheet WINS over this file. Keys = exact institution names from BR_BANKS.

_fields.url2: second document merged into the same text
_fields.page: the bank's rate-sheet LISTING page. Since 21 Aug 2026 the pipeline reads this page every run, date-ranks every PDF on it (filename, link text, or /uploads/YYYY/MM/ path) and takes the NEWEST - so a rotating filename fixes itself. Pair it with pdfMatch.
_fields.pdfMatch: regex picking the right document when a page lists several, e.g. 'Provisional' to skip 'Final Rates'
_fields.pdfMatch2: same, for the second merged document (set in the .gs, not overridable yet)
_fields.route: 'bb' + re:'NAME REGEX' - primary source died, serve that institution from Bangladesh Bank's chart instead (Tier R)
_fields.values: {savings,fdr_3m,fdr_6m,fdr_1y,fdr_3y,dps_3y,dps_5y} - emergency manual pin, skips the fetch entirely
_fields.asof: pin the effective date shown on the site (yyyy-mm-dd). Normally the pipeline reads this out of the document itself.
_fields.tier: P primary / R regulator / B portal / Pr press
_fields.srcName: the source label shown in the row's info popover
_fields.skip: true - institution gone, show an honest no-data row

_notes: Nothing is ever held waiting for approval any more. A row that trips a check publishes with a visible badge, so an override is about ACCURACY, never about un-hiding a row.
AsOf is the date the institution's own sheet took effect, not the date we read it. Only pin 'asof' when the document genuinely carries no readable date.
Unknown keys and bad JSON are ignored fail-safe. KEEP THIS FILE VALID JSON.
